summary: Frontend-only verification of the rewritten storyboard content + the two NEW interactive behaviors: (1) Scanning page AUTO-ADVANCE via setTimeout to /commerce/verdict, and (2) Agent page collapsible done-card file row with blue Copy -> 'Copied' button. Tested at 1440x900 desktop against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview. 99% of storyboard checks pass. Found ONE real bug on the Agent Copy button that emits an UNHANDLED promise rejection (NotAllowedError) which triggers a webpack dev-server runtime-error overlay that blocks subsequent clicks in dev mode.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a Promise. The current try/catch (lines 96-104) does NOT catch the async rejection. In the sandboxed/cross-origin preview iframe the call rejects with 'NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' That unhandled rejection is intercepted by webpack-dev-server's runtime-error overlay which paints a full-screen modal that blocks ALL subsequent pointer events (including the file toggle button, halfway submit, nav links). The UI label correctly toggles Copy -> Copied -> Copy, so the visual contract works; only the unhandled rejection is the problem. In a production build the overlay won't appear but the unhandled rejection still pollutes the console and could break analytics / error reporting.

issues: Recharts still logs two non-blocking width(-1) / height(-1) warnings on initial mount (carried over from iteration_1, acceptable per spec).

action_items: FIX: Agent.jsx FixCard.doCopy — wrap or .catch() the navigator.clipboard.writeText() promise so the async rejection in sandboxed iframes does not bubble as an unhandled rejection. Suggested patch: `const doCopy = () => { Promise.resolve(navigator.clipboard?.writeText(fix.code || '')).catch(() => {}); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); };` — the current try/catch only catches sync throws, not the returned promise's rejection.
Optional: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Monitor by giving the ResponsiveContainer parent an explicit min-height/aspect (carried over).
critical_code_review_comments: Agent.jsx doCopy uses synchronous try/catch around an async navigator.clipboard.writeText() — the rejection is uncaught. This is the root cause of the dev-server error overlay observed during testing.
Scanning.jsx setTimeout chain works correctly: 5 lines x 800ms = 4000ms, then score at 4800ms, then auto-nav at 7000ms. Cleanup via clearTimeout on unmount is correct.
Landing.jsx Counter setInterval(100ms) increments by 300-1200 per tick — that's 4500-18000 per second, which can drift very fast over a long visit (no upper bound). Cosmetic, not a bug.
Verdict.jsx still imports `Box` but the bottom CTA section uses an h3 with `<Box>why.</Box>` which is fine. No dead code added by this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: All storyboard content checks pass. 1 high-priority interaction bug (Copy unhandled rejection).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All storyboard CONTENT and the scanning AUTO-ADVANCE (most important new behavior) are verified working end-to-end. The Agent collapsible file toggle + Copy->Copied label toggle works visually. The single open bug is that clicking Copy in the preview iframe triggers an unhandled clipboard.writeText() promise rejection (NotAllowedError) which surfaces as a webpack-dev-server runtime-error overlay that subsequently blocks pointer events for the rest of the page. Fix in Agent.jsx FixCard.doCopy by attaching .catch() to the promise. After fix, retest by: open /commerce/agent -> click any data-testid='fix-file-toggle-llms.txt' -> click data-testid='fix-copy-llms.txt' -> verify NO error overlay appears AND that subsequent clicks (e.g., nav-link-monitor) still work.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Agent.jsx line ~96-104, the doCopy handler is `const doCopy = () => { try { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(fix.code || ''); } catch (e) {} ... }`. Because writeText() returns a Promise, the synchronous try/catch never catches a rejection. In the Emergent preview iframe the Clipboard API rejects with 'NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.'. The unhandled rejection is picked up by react-error-overlay (webpack-dev-server) which renders a full-screen modal that intercepts all pointer events. Reproduction: navigate to /commerce/agent, expand any done card (fix-file-toggle-llms.txt), click the blue Copy button (fix-copy-llms.txt) — the overlay appears immediately. Mitigation: `.catch(() => {})` the writeText promise, OR await inside an async try/catch, OR use document.execCommand('copy') as fallback. The visible 'Copied' label toggling itself is unaffected and works correctly.
